title: A Single Equation Explains Go-or-Grow Dynamics in Cyclic Hypoxia
summary: We propose a minimal mathematical framework to describe the go-or-grow dynamics of tumor cells comprising two phenotypically distinct populations. One population is migratory and undergoes linear diffusion, while the other proliferates in an oxygen-dependent manner. The local oxygen concentration governs transitions between these phenotypes. We then ask whether these two coupled phenotype-specific equations can be reduced to a single mixed-phenotype equation under cyclic hypoxia.
